meta.title: Assign one item from its Assignee cell

plan.title: Assign PR Item from Assignee Cell

steps.note: Open Purchase Requisitions as the starting screen for the PR assignment flow.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-2 is available.

args.goal: find PR-2 in the Open Purchase Requisitions list, open the Assignee cell in its item row, verify the picker shows only users who can see PR-2 including Engg Buyer (User C), select Engg Buyer (User C), and stop with the PR-2 row showing User C as its assignee

steps.note: Perform the row-level assignment and inspect the eligible-user list, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert that the assigned PR-2 row visibly shows User C after the assignment.
